watches.name: Royal Marines Green
watches.description: The Royal Marines watch is defined by its bold, contemporary presence: a sturdy 42 mm steel case frames a striking green dial marked by applied indexes and crisp steel hands, all glowing with SuperLuminova for striking contrast and legibility. The elegant sapphire crystal and date window enrich a look that is both refined and assertive. Its Italian-made calf leather strap, treated for water resistance, is trimmed with a soft Alcantara lining and a custom steel buckle, ensuring the ultimate blend of classic style and modern endurance.

watches.description: The Voyager S watch impresses with a sleek black dial, refined by applied indexes and steel hands treated with SuperLuminova for excellent low-light visibility. This sophisticated timepiece is anchored by a five-row stainless steel bracelet with a deployant buckle enhanced by ceramic spheres, combining durability and luxury. Its robust design is ready for any adventure with 200m water resistance.

watches.name: SD 911 Black
watches.description: The 911 watch channels the energy of a sports car tachometer within a polished 42.5 mm stainless steel case. Gladiator-style hands, treated with Super-LumiNova, ensure excellent legibility, while the red seconds hand echoes the needle of the 911’s rev counter. The watch features a date display and an anti-scratch sapphire crystal with multi-layer anti-reflective and anti-fingerprint coatings for maximum clarity. Soft black nappa leather, handcrafted in Italy, completes the piece with a strap that recalls the car’s iconic seats, where precise stitching and sculpted contours deliver both comfort and style.
